Learn more delivery customer access:
Your customer does not need to download any app. The menu opens on their phone, in the way that is easiest for them:

• QR Code — they point the camera (at the table, counter, or packaging) and the menu opens.
• WhatsApp — you send the link in the chat and they tap to order.
• Instagram — they open it from your restaurant’s profile.
• Fridge magnet — with NeuraBar Tag technology, hold the phone close and view the menu.

Learn more delivery order flow:
The order arrives straight in the kitchen. You decide whether to accept it or not.

The customer follows each step on their phone:
• Order sent
• Order accepted
• In production
• Out for delivery
• Delivered

We also save the customer's name and phone number, so you keep an order history for each person.
Direct print sales copy:
Direct Print — the order goes to the kitchen without anyone having to shout

As soon as the order is placed, it prints automatically in the kitchen or at the bar — no waiter leaving their station, no handwritten tickets, no lost orders.

Fewer mistakes, less rushing, faster service.
Learn more direct print how it works:
Every new order prints a ticket in each station — kitchen, bar, or wherever you need it.

Once the ticket comes out, the team already knows what to prepare. You can also use it to send the order straight to the customer.

Less hassle and more speed.

Direct waiter sales copy:
Direct Garçom — this is our favorite 🤩

You put the NeuraBar Tag on the table and that's it: guests start ordering straight from the system, without calling anyone.

You know when they just want another drink and already know what they want? With DIRECT, they place the order themselves in seconds — no waiting, no fuss. You save time, your waiter gets a break, and the guest leaves happy.

Just by placing NeuraBar Tags on each table or spot, you already gain speed in service.

The guest orders quickly, the order arrives quickly, and the waiter is free for other tables.

Financial dashboard sales copy:
Financial Dashboard — everything that happened in your venue, in one place

How many tables were served, what sold the most, what guests always order, how last month went, how last year went — all recorded and easy to see.

With this data in hand, you start making decisions with more confidence. For example: if November is going well, you can already compare with last year's November and get ready for an even better December.

No more guessing. Here, you know.
Learn more financial dashboard advantage:
No spreadsheets. No wasted time.

You see live how sales are going in your venue.

With the data in hand, in real time, it is easy to make decisions and build your plan.
Fiscal note sales copy:
Fiscal Note — issue it without leaving the system

When closing the check, you issue the fiscal receipt straight from NeuraBar — with or without the customer's CPF/CNPJ, in seconds.

Need a full invoice (DANFE) for a supplier or another purpose? That's here too. Everything in the same place, without opening another program, without the hassle.
Delivery sales copy:
Delivery and pickup orders — straight from the phone, no middlemen

Your customers open your up-to-date menu from any phone, anytime, and order directly from you — no calls, no mix-ups.

Best of all: you pay nothing per order. Unlike iFood and other apps, there is no delivery fee here. After a few orders, the activation pays for itself.
